compiled:
📰 General

Murray and Ferguson Tour Washington Flood Damage Amidst Further Rainfall Threats •

Senator Patty Murray and Governor Jay Inslee visited Skagit County, Washington, on Tuesday to assess the extensive damage caused by recent flooding. The area has experienced significant evacuations due to the unusually powerful atmospheric river bringing torrential rainfall. Authorities are preparing for further rainfall and potential worsening conditions across the Pacific Northwest. Teams are focused on providing support to displaced residents and evaluating the scale of the devastation.

🌍 World

Russian Drone Strike Targets Turkish Civilian Vessel in Black Sea Waters •

Ukrainian Naval Forces reported that Russia launched a drone attack against a civilian vessel operating in the Black Sea on November 13, 2025. The attack occurred in international waters, according to initial reports. The Ukrainian military stated that the Russian Federation conducted the targeted strike, though details regarding the vessel’s identity and the extent of the damage remain unconfirmed. This incident marks another instance of alleged Russian aggression in the Black Sea region.

🦅 US

Trump Vows Retaliation Following Deadly Attack on U.S. and Syrian Patrol in Syria •

Two U.S. Army soldiers and a U.S. civilian interpreter were killed during an operation in Syria’s Palmyra region on Saturday. The incident occurred when shots were fired at U.S. and Syrian forces while they were conducting a mission to the historic town. President Trump stated that the United States would “retaliate” for the attack, according to a White House statement. The operation was aimed at assessing security conditions in the area, and the investigation into the circumstances surrounding the shooting is ongoing.

💰 Business

Juventus Owners Firmly Reject $1.2 Billion Takeover Bid from Tether •

Juventus’ Agnelli family has officially declined a $1.2 billion takeover proposal from cryptocurrency firm Tether. The offer, made public on Saturday, would have transferred control of the Italian footballing giant to the company behind the world’s largest stablecoin. This decision secures the Agnelli family’s continued ownership of the club, which has historically been the most successful in Serie A. The rejection comes after protracted negotiations regarding the potential sale of a majority stake.

💻 Technology

PS Plus Extra & Premium December 2025 Game Lineup Revealed – Subscribers Weigh In •

Sony has announced the nine games slated for release within the PS Plus Extra and Premium tiers in December 2025. The lineup includes titles available on both PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4, catering to a wide range of players. Initial reactions to the selection are being gathered through a recent poll, examining subscriber satisfaction with the announced titles. The release represents a continued expansion of content for subscribers of the premium services.

🎭 Entertainment

Amazon Prime Video Subscribers Receive Free Access to Ad-Free X-Ray •

Amazon Prime Video is offering its U.S. subscribers a free upgrade to ad-free X-Ray. This enhancement allows users to watch movies and TV shows without advertisements appearing during playback. The upgrade is available to all current Prime Video subscribers, providing a significant benefit for viewers. Amazon is rolling out this feature as part of a broader effort to enhance the Prime Video experience.

🏅 Sports

ASU and Kenny Dillingham Near Agreement on Amended Contract Details •

Arizona State University and head football coach Kenny Dillingham are reportedly nearing an agreement on a revised contract. Discussions initiated following the conclusion of the regular season focused on increasing Dillingham’s base salary. Details of the amendment remain undisclosed, but the move signals a significant investment by the program. The specific terms of the revised compensation package are currently under negotiation.

🔬 Science

Vladimir Komarov’s Final Transmission Reveals a Harrowing Spacecraft Failure •

In 1967, cosmonaut Vladimir Komarov tragically died during the Soyuz 1 mission, marking a critical setback for the Soviet space program. The mission involved a planned spacewalk, but a parachute failure caused the spacecraft to rapidly de-orbit and crash land in the Ural Mountains. Komarov’s last recorded words, transmitted moments before impact, detailed the unfolding disaster and the loss of control. Analysis of the wreckage revealed a faulty valve in the return propulsion system as the primary cause of the catastrophic failure.

🩺 Health

RFK Jr.’s Actions and Statements Fuel Vaccine Hesitancy, Threatening Public Health. •

Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s continued promotion of misinformation regarding vaccines has significantly contributed to heightened vaccine hesitancy across the United States. His statements questioning the safety and efficacy of vaccines, particularly against COVID-19 and measles, have been widely disseminated through social media and public appearances. The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) has formally accused Kennedy of disseminating false or misleading information about vaccines, citing specific instances of misleading claims. HHS’s concerns center on Kennedy’s repeated assertions that vaccines cause autism and other adverse health effects, despite overwhelming scientific evidence to the contrary.
